description:
Addresses findings from the /review on the Phase 3 coder branch
(review/octo-t58, commits 8bea0e8..f6d6951). The RPC event-
forwarding bug is a correctness issue worth fixing before the
coder layer gets used; the rest are polish + hardening.

Children cover:
  - RPC event forwarding wiring bug (events silently dropped
    because subscribe target was the CLI main pid, not the
    forwarder process)
  - Session cwd enforcement for tool paths (tools currently
    accept any absolute path; cwd rooting deferred in Phase 3)
  - read.ex off-by-one for files without trailing newline +
    streaming refactor
  - grep/find abort-responsiveness + rg availability cache
  - Bash :kill_group revisit (orphan process group leaks on abort)
  - RPC event serialization richness (current shape is lossy)
  - Integration + end-to-end test coverage gaps (`mix pi --print`
    against live Anthropic, RPC request+events flow)
  - Style/docs cleanup grab-bag
title: [EPIC] Phase 3 review cleanup (octo-t58 review findings)
